title: test_ecdsa_roundtrip uses internal wc_CryptoInfo directly instead of public wolfSSL API
description: test_ecdsa_roundtrip (test.c:458-467) fills a wc_CryptoInfo struct manually and calls wc_crypto2dev_cb() directly to trigger SETKEY. The comment justifies this as 'same TU as the port'. The correct trigger for SETKEY is wolfSSL's public API (e.g., via wc_ecc_copy to a device-bound key, or wolfSSL_SetDevId + key import via SSL handshake). The direct wc_CryptoInfo manipulation means the test bypasses wolfSSL's own dispatch — it doesn't test that wolfSSL actually routes to the callback at SETKEY time, only that the callback handler works when called directly. Also fragile: wc_CryptoInfo layout changes silently break this test.
